name: JAKA
summary:
JAKA develops collaborative robots, humanoid platforms and integrated automation systems. Its established industrial offering combines robot arms with vision and control technology for applications such as assembly, machine loading, sorting, handling, dispensing and inspection. The portfolio serves sectors including automotive production, electronics, appliances and food service.

The company is also developing embodied-intelligence products, including small humanoids and systems for mobile manipulation and robot-data collection. Its public materials describe applications in education, entertainment, companionship and research as well as factories. This links its experience in production automation with tools and platforms for developing more general robot capabilities.
